financial_units: Only exact source column labels declare units. SOURCE_LITERAL_YUAN is the literal 元 unit, not an inferred CNY/FX contract. Display precision and nonnumeric P/L tokens remain original observations, separate from canonical statements.
knowledge_rule: Actual new governance observation; retain all original capture, update and source clocks as local evidence. No historic PIT or publication instant inferred.
holder_rule: Certify complete original dated source frames separately; retain source ordinal/component/denominator. Never infer an exit/zero from an absent or truncated holder.
change_equivalence_rule: Only explicit original event identity/source lineage may establish transaction equivalence. Same holder/day/amount is an overlap candidate, not proof. No implicit source priority.
